title: Escort Lures Man to Brutal Murder Over Unpaid Services
description:
Macon police responded after 27-year-old Jada Simone Johnson reported a shooting at her apartment. Officers found 39-year-old Waymond Danzy fatally shot. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
